prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need SEO, paid media, content, creative, growth strategy, or a full-service partner.

If you tell me a few details I can recommend 3–5 agencies that are a good fit. Useful things to share:
- Your business type (B2B SaaS, ecommerce, local service, consumer brand, etc.)
- Primary goals (lead gen, revenue, brand awareness, fundraising traction, traffic, conversions)
- Monthly marketing budget (or retainer range)
- Channels you care about (SEO, Google Ads, social, content, CRO, email)
- Preference for agency size (boutique vs large/enterprise) and contract length

While you decide, here are quick ways to find and vet agencies in SF, plus a short checklist you can use right away:

Where to find agencies
- Clutch.co, TheManifest, G2 — filter by San Francisco and service
- LinkedIn searches and recommendations
- Referrals from other founders/CMOs in your vertical

Vet them with these questions
- Do you have case studies with companies like ours? (same industry, size, KPIs)
- What results did you deliver and over what timeframe?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and what reporting will we get?
- What tools do you use (analytics, ad platforms, SEO tools)?
- What does onboarding and the first 90 days look like?
- Typical pricing model and minimum contract term

If you want, tell me the 5 details above and I’ll return a tailored shortlist of top SF agencies (with strengths, what to expect, and suggested intro email) within a few minutes. Which business are we picking for?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
